name: 便捷输入框
author: mengge237
description: 把 DSH 输入框做成 VS Code 手感：括号与引号自动配对（含全角），选中一段再打符号直接框住；补全弹层给本文词、语言词表、工作区文件与模型名，打满两个字符自动弹、Tab 接受、回车保持发送。标准 DSH bundle 插件：一条命令安装，不依赖第三方运行时、不写任何文件、不改宿主源码。语言词表在服务端半边，改过词表需重启一次 dsh web。
descriptionEn: VS Code feel for the DSH composer: auto-pairs for brackets and quotes (full-width included), wrap-on-selection, and a completion popup over draft words, language tables, workspace files and model names — opens at two characters, Tab accepts, Enter still sends. Standard DSH bundle plugin: one-line install, no third-party runtime, no file writes, no host patches. Language tables live in the server half; restart dsh web after changing them.
